correctness.rationale: Explicit eleven-element neighborhoods give a pure ten-dimensional complex with 111482 nonempty simplices. The reproducible complete algorithm validates 54910 elementary simplicial collapse pairs and reduces to a 56/628/978 two-complex. An independently acyclicity-checked 569 edge/triangle matching and 55 spanning-tree pairs leave 1 critical vertex, 4 edges and 409 triangles. The acyclic word dependency reduction gives exact CW relators; three elementary 1/2-cell cancellations leave 406 relators on one circle with degrees -2 (60), 0 (299), 2 (47). One degree-2 attachment yields RP2; all remaining attachments are null in RP2, yielding RP2 wedge 405 S2. Direct F2/F3/F5 ranks verify b1/b2 values (1,406)/(0,405)/(0,405). No claim beyond this exact finite object.

value.rationale: The first square-overlap-rich triple Kneser graph after KG(7,3) has a natural 56-facet radius-one Čech nerve, yet its integral homotopy includes RP2 and genuine 2-torsion. The exact complete homotopy decomposition, 405 sphere count, and high-dimensional non-shellability obstruction are not textbook face-count consequences. This specifically distinguishes closed-neighborhood topology from better-studied open-neighborhood Kneser behavior and provides a new finite structural benchmark.
